main:5.text: Black Mesa East was a major Resistance base located at the Wasteland outside of City 17, opposite to a dam, its generating station and its reservoir, and right next to the abandoned mining town of Ravenholm. Black Mesa East is where Doctor Eli Vance, Judith Mossman, Alyx Vance, and many other Resistance members, including several Vortigaunts, used to live before its destruction.

main:9.text: Nova Prospekt is a largely abandoned prison that was, according to Alyx Vance, transformed into "something much worse" by the Combine located on the Coast. Prior to the Combine occupation, it was a high-security prison; but was turned into a coastal stronghold for the Combine. Nova Prospekt is separated into two parts as illustrated respectively in the two chapters of the game titled Nova Prospekt and Entanglement.

main:14.text: Dark Energy is an underlying background energy that exists in space and throughout the entire universe. It is normally unable to be detected by conventional means, and indeed its existence was considered purely theoretical in the early 21st century Earth. On large scales, it opposes the force of gravity, causing the universe to expand.
